You are a world-class UI designer and frontend engineer. Your only job is to make SkillosAI look and feel like a $200M SaaS product. Do NOT change any logic, API calls, state management, data fetching, or business functionality. Change ONLY: colors, typography, spacing, shadows, borders, animations, layout proportions, and visual presentation of existing content.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STRICT RULES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
- Touch ZERO files under /app/api/, /lib/, /middleware.ts
- Do NOT install any npm packages
- Do NOT change variable names, function signatures, props, or data structures
- Do NOT remove any existing JSX elements — only restyle them
- Do NOT change dark/light mode system — only enhance it
- Return COMPLETE file content for every file changed
- Run `npx tsc --noEmit` at the end and fix all errors

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
DESIGN REFERENCE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Target aesthetic: Vercel + Linear + Stripe
- Clean, confident, minimal
- Strong typographic hierarchy
- Generous whitespace
- Subtle depth (soft shadows, not harsh)
- Smooth micro-animations
- Every page feels designed, not coded
- One design language across ALL pages
- Anxious users must feel SAFE and IN CONTROL

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
VISUAL RULES — APPLY EVERYWHERE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

TYPOGRAPHY
- Display headings: font-bold tracking-tight leading-[1.08]
- Hero h1: text-[clamp(2rem,5vw,3.75rem)]
- Section h2: text-3xl font-bold
- Card titles: text-lg font-semibold
- Body: text-base leading-relaxed text-[color:var(--text-secondary)]
- Labels: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[color:var(--muted)]
- Numbers/stats: font-bold tabular-nums
- Max 3 text sizes per section — never more

SPACING (8px grid only)
- Section vertical padding: py-20 sm:py-28
- Card internal padding: p-6
- Grid gaps: gap-4 or gap-6
- Between heading and body: mb-4
- Between body and CTA: mt-8

COLORS — use CSS variables, not hardcoded hex
- Headings: text-[color:var(--text)]
- Body: text-[color:var(--text-secondary)]
- Subtle: text-[color:var(--muted)]
- Borders: border-[color:var(--border)]
- Card backgrounds: bg-[color:var(--surface)]
- Page background: bg-[color:var(--bg)]
- Brand: bg-[color:var(--primary)] text-white

CARDS — one style only
- className="rounded-2xl border border-[color:var(--border)] bg-[color:var(--surface)] p-6 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200"
- Never mix different card styles on the same page
- No harsh box shadows

BUTTONS — two styles only
- Primary: "inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[color:var(--primary)] text-white text-sm font-semibold hover:opacity-90 transition-all duration-150 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-px active:translate-y-0"
- Secondary: "inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-[color:var(--border)] bg-[color:var(--surface)] text-[color:var(--text)] text-sm font-semibold hover:border-[color:var(--primary)]/40 transition-all duration-150"
- Remove ALL other button variants that look different from these two

INPUTS — one style only
- className="w-full h-11 px-4 rounded-xl border border-[color:var(--border)] bg-[color:var(--surface)] text-[color:var(--text)] placeholder:text-[color:var(--muted)] text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-[color:var(--primary)] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[color:var(--primary)]/10 transition-all"
- Apply this to EVERY input, textarea, select on every page

STATUS BADGES — four styles only, use these exact classNames:
- Safe/Low:    "inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20"
- Monitor/Med: "inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20"
- High:        "inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-orange-500/10 text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400 border border-orange-500/20"
- Critical:    "inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-red-500/10 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 border border-red-500/20"

ANIMATIONS — subtle only
- All interactive elements: transition-all duration-150
- Cards on hover: hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-0.5
- Buttons on hover: hover:-translate-y-px
- Page sections: opacity-0 → opacity-1 + translateY(16px) → 0 on scroll via IntersectionObserver
- Loading states: animate-pulse on skeleton divs
- Zero animations that delay content

REMOVE VISUAL NOISE
- Remove all horizontal <hr> dividers — use spacing instead
- Remove any element with more than 2 nested border+shadow+rounded combinations
- Remove any rainbow or neon gradient that isn't a single brand-color gradient
- Remove all inline style={{ color: '#hex' }} — convert to Tailwind/CSS var
- Maximum 2 different border-radius values per page (rounded-xl and rounded-2xl)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PAGE-BY-PAGE INSTRUCTIONS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

── styles/globals.css ──
Add ONLY at the end, change nothing else:

```css
/* Hero ambient glow */
.hero-glow::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: -100px; left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 700px; height: 400px;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(99,102,241,0.10) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
}
.dark .hero-glow::before {
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(99,102,241,0.16) 0%, transparent 70%);
}

/* Dot grid for empty/hero sections */
.dot-grid-bg {
  background-image: radial-gradient(circle, var(--border) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 22px 22px;
}

/* Gradient text for hero headline accent */
.text-gradient {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary) 0%, #8b5cf6 60%, #06b6d4 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
}

/* Scroll reveal */
.reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px); transition: opacity 0.45s ease, transform 0.45s ease; }
.reveal.visible { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

/* Metric card */
.metric-card { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; }
.metric-value { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--text); }
.metric-label { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 4px; }

/* Eyebrow badge */
.eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(99,102,241,0.10); border: 1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.20); color: var(--primary); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; margin-bottom: 20px; }

/* Page content wrapper */
.page-wrap { width: 100%; max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }
.page-wrap-sm { width: 100%; max-width: 720px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }

/* Thin scrollbar */
::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 5px; height: 5px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border); border-radius: 99px; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
h1, h2, h3 { text-wrap: balance; }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; transition: none; }
}
```

── components/AppLayout.tsx ──

This is the most impactful change — it unlocks full-bleed sections on every page.

── components/Navbar.tsx ──
1. Add scroll detection:
   const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false)
   useEffect(() => {
     const fn = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 8)
     window.addEventListener('scroll', fn, { passive: true })
     return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', fn)
   }, [])
2. Nav outer className: add `${scrolled ? 'shadow-sm' : ''}` and `backdrop-blur-md transition-shadow duration-200`
3. Logo — replace letter-box with gradient icon mark:
   <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br from-[color:var(--primary)] to-violet-600 flex items-center justify-center">

     </svg>
